Start smaller than you think you need to. The purpose is to support movement, not to demand a particular mood.

The activity suggestions reuse the 225-item source library from Emotion Regulation Handout 16. [Review the source-backed Behavioural Activation lesson](/learn/wellness/behavioral-activation.html).

## Learn from the activity

Note what you expect before trying an activity, then record what happened. Consider connection, enjoyment, or accomplishment as well as mood. Rest and necessary care can belong in the plan. Look for patterns across attempts rather than treating one difficult day as a failed test.

For several days of observations, use the [Activity & Mood Log](/tool-finder/activity-mood-log/). It can show patterns that one plan cannot.

Additional reflections informed by Greenberger and Padesky, [*Mind Over Mood*, second edition (2016)](https://www.mindovermood.com/), Chapter 13.
